name: Chase overdue invoices with 3-tier escalating Gmail reminders from Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## Chase overdue invoices with 3-tier escalating Gmail reminders from Google Sheets

### How it works

This workflow runs every morning at 9:00 to review overdue invoices stored in Google Sheets. It builds tiered reminder messages for unpaid invoices, sends customer reminders through Gmail, and logs the outreach back to the tracker. For invoices that reach the final-notice tier, it also sends an internal escalation alert.

### Setup steps

- Configure Google Sheets credentials for both reading and updating the invoice tracker.
- Configure Gmail credentials for sending customer reminders and internal escalation alerts.
- Set the schedule trigger timezone and confirm it should run daily at 9:00.
- Update the Google Sheets node settings to point to the correct spreadsheet, sheet, and required invoice columns.
- Review the code in the reminder-building node to ensure the overdue thresholds, tier logic, email copy, and recipient fields match your process.

### Customization

Adjust the escalation tiers, reminder wording, sender/recipient addresses, and logging fields to match your collections policy.

## Schedule and prepare reminders

Starts the workflow every morning, reads the invoice tracker from Google Sheets, and classifies unpaid invoices into reminder tiers while drafting the appropriate email content.

## Send and log reminders

Sends the customer reminder emails through Gmail, then records the reminder activity back into the invoice tracker.

## Handle final escalation

Checks whether an invoice has reached the final notice tier and, when applicable, sends an internal escalation alert by Gmail.

parameters.message: ={{ 'Final notice was just sent to ' + $json.ClientName + ' (' + $json.ClientEmail + ') for invoice ' + $json.InvoiceNumber + ', amount ' + $json.Amount + ' ' + $json.Currency + ', due ' + $json.DueDate + ' (' + $json.daysOverdue + ' days overdue, reminder #' + $json.remindersSent + ').\n\nConsider pausing work for this client or handing the case to collections.' }}

### 📋 Required sheet columns (tab name: `Invoices`)

| Column | Example |
|---|---|
| InvoiceNumber | INV-2041 |
| ClientName | Acme LLC |
| ClientEmail | billing@acme.com |
| Amount | 1250.00 |
| Currency | USD |
| DueDate | 2026-07-15 (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| Status | unpaid / paid |
| LastReminderDate | auto-filled |
| RemindersSent | auto-filled |

Mark an invoice `paid` and it is ignored forever.

### 🚀 Want this wired into QuickBooks, Xero or Stripe?

This free template runs off a Google Sheet so anyone can use it. I also build versions that pull invoices straight from **QuickBooks / Xero / Stripe**, add **SMS or WhatsApp escalation**, and auto-pause services for chronic late payers.

Async delivery, no calls needed — check my creator profile for contact links.
